_about: Game-term glossary for KingdomOps localization. One entry per game term the site uses; for each of the 13 site languages it records the string the localized game client (or its community) uses, where it came from, a status and a date. Status: verified-official = seen in official Lilith material (store listing, official site/forum, regional official posts, patch notes in that language) or in the owner's own client screenshots; community = found in a wiki, guide, video or player post in that language; unverified = inferred/machine, no source. Never upgrade a status without a source. `enGlossaryId` links to packages/planner/tools-data/glossary.json (EN definitions). Validator: packages/data/scripts/check-glossary.ts.

languages.note: The id Google Play listing mixes Malay paragraphs; Malay-only words found there were not accepted as Indonesian.

languages.name: Tiếng Việt
languages.note: Vietnam also has the Gamota edition (local publisher). Many VI community guides describe Gamota; its strings may differ from the global client's Vietnamese.

languages.name: 한국어
languages.note: Korea has its own App Store app (id1474599374, official Naver cafe). Its marketing copy is used as an official source.

languages.name: 繁體中文
languages.note: Traditional Chinese: the global client's Chinese option used by Taiwan/HK players (Google Play zh-TW listing of com.lilithgame.roc.gp is Traditional, game name 萬國覺醒). Mainland players use the separate 万国觉醒 app. zh-Hans can be derived later with OpenCC plus a reviewer pass.
